errors.text: The proposed oxygen-or-nitrogen interstitial intervention does not reconstruct the target addition of 4.2 at.% Cr to HfMoTaTiZr.
None of the cited evidence directly supports oxygen/nitrogen interstitial strengthening or ordered interstitial complexes in the proposed bulk refractory alloy system.
The intervention is not uniquely specified: oxygen and nitrogen are distinct interventions, and neither concentration nor a definite host composition is given.
The hypothesis substitutes testing above 500 °C for the target room-temperature compression conditions and does not test preservation of room-temperature performance.
The expected improvement is neither quantitative nor tied to a specific baseline.
The falsification experiment lacks composition and dose control, mediator measurements, statistical thresholds, and a simultaneous room-temperature performance criterion.
